messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "consult doctor or pharmacist if using without prescription and have medical conditions"
set: ["consult doctor or pharmacist if using without prescription and have medical conditions", "consult doctor or pharmacist about safety", "child or other person using medicine without prescription", "dose adjustment needed if have other medical conditions", "inform doctor or pharmacist if have liver problems", "consult doctor or pharmacist if unsure whether medication is an MAOI", "other medical conditions", "certain medical conditions", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if you have questions", "consult doctor or pharmacist before using other medicines for pain, fever, swelling, or cold/flu symptoms", "risk especially high in people using without prescription", "tell doctor about all medical conditions", "tell doctor about all medical conditions and drugs used", "consult doctor if have head injury or increased pressure inside skull", "consult a doctor or pharmacist before taking multivitamins, mineral supplements, or antacids", "tell your doctor or pharmacist if you have a latex allergy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
